concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-apac-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree APAC-route article for updating the business checking account used for settled-transaction payouts through a Control Panel document upload, with a three-month statement alternative, Hong Kong/Malaysia/Singapore sort-code qualifiers and a same-country business-checking condition; not a complete APAC country or permission catalog, proof of current eligibility or completed change, or evidence for the presence or absence of an API route
warnings: Keep the APAC route snapshot separate from Australia and sibling regional or processor-specific procedures.
The source documents a Control Panel upload but does not state the required user role or permission and does not establish whether an API route exists.
